dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mets Blast Past Braves, Francisco Lindor Crushes Two Homers**

Francisco Lindor torched the Atlanta Braves with two home runs, six RBIs, and three hits in a 14-3 New York Mets rout. Lindor's 8th home run of the season highlighted his dominant performance. Meanwhile, Daniel Duarte threw two scoreless innings with three strikeouts in relief. In the American League, the Houston Astros edged the Los Angeles Angels 6-4, with Cristian Javier tossing five shutout innings and Vaughn Grissom hitting two RBIs with a home run.
